license_required.quote: Optometry is hereby declared to be a profession

issuing_authority.value: New Jersey State Board of Optometrists
issuing_authority.quote: the New Jersey State Board of Optometrists

name.value: New Jersey State Board of Optometrists
name.quote: The New Jersey State Board of Optometrists, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board"

type.quote: The New Jersey State Board of Optometrists, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board", created and established by the act entitled "An act to regulate the practice of optometry, to license optometrists"

exams.name: Optometry licensing examination
exams.quote: the practice of optometry is defined to be the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae

interval_years.quote: all professional or occupational licenses or certificates of registration, except such licenses or certificates issued to real estate brokers or salesmen pursuant to chapter 15 of Title 45, which prior to the effective date of this act were issued for periods not exceeding one year and were annually renewable, shall, on and after the effective date of this act, be issued for periods of two years and be biennially renewable

requirements.value: Applicant must hold valid, current corresponding license in good standing from another state with substantially equivalent education, training, and examination requirements; must have been practicing within five years prior to application; must satisfy criminal background check and other requirements
requirements.quote: a board shall issue a professional or occupational license, certificate of registration, or certification to any person who documents that the person holds a valid, current corresponding professional or occupational license, certificate of registration, or certification in good standing issued by another state, if: (1) the state that issued the license has, or had at the time of issuance, education, training, and examination requirements for licensure, registration, or certification substantially equivalent to the current standards of this State

regulatory_model.quote: the practice of optometry is defined to be the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae

credential_type.quote: Optometry is hereby declared to be a profession, and the practice of optometry is defined

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of this chapter who in any way advertises himself as an optometrist, or who shall employ any means for the measurement of the powers of vision or the adaptation of lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, practice, offer or attempt to practice optometry as herein defined

title_protection.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of this chapter who in any way advertises himself as an optometrist

scope_protection.quote: the practice of optometry is defined to be the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained license through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered life, health, welfare, safety or property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in professional or occupational misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of crime with direct or substantial relationship to regulated activity or inconsistent with public health, safety, or welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had authority to practice revoked or suspended by another state for reasons consistent with disciplinary grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapable for medical or other good cause of discharging functions consistent with public health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use likely to impair ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted unlicensed person or entity to perform act requiring license or aided and abetted unlicensed practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

definition_quote.value: the practice of optometry is defined to be the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, or the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction, and excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226 (C.24:21-5 and C.24:21-6), except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385 (C.45:12-9.11), for the purposes of treating deficiencies, deformities, diseases, or abnormalities of the human eye and adnexae, including the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae
definition_quote.quote: the practice of optometry is defined to be the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, or the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction, and excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226 (C.24:21-5 and C.24:21-6), except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385 (C.45:12-9.11), for the purposes of treating deficiencies, deformities, diseases, or abnormalities of the human eye and adnexae, including the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae

methods_authorized.quote: the employment of objective or subjective means, or both, for the examination of the human eye and adnexae for the purposes of ascertaining any departure from the normal, measuring its powers of vision and adapting lenses or prisms for the aid thereof, or the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction, and excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226 (C.24:21-5 and C.24:21-6), except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385 (C.45:12-9.11), for the purposes of treating deficiencies, deformities, diseases, or abnormalities of the human eye and adnexae, including the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae. The practice of optometry shall include the administration of immunizations against coronaviruses and influenza by any route or modality

drug_authority.value: use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction, and excluding controlled dangerous substances except as otherwise authorized
drug_authority.quote: the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction, and excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226 (C.24:21-5 and C.24:21-6), except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385 (C.45:12-9.11)

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: including the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexae

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: excluding injections, except for injections to counter anaphylactic reaction

immunization_authority.quote: The practice of optometry shall include the administration of immunizations against coronaviruses and influenza by any route or modality, provided that administration of the immunization is consistent with recommendations issued by the Advisory Committee for Immunization Practices in the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

value: Schedules II, III, IV, and V controlled dangerous substances are excluded from optometric prescribing authority except as otherwise authorized
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: excluding controlled dangerous substances as provided in sections 5 and 6 of P.L.1970, c.226 (C.24:21-5 and C.24:21-6), except as otherwise authorized by section 9 of P.L.1991, c.385 (C.45:12-9.11)

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No licensee shall be certified by the New Jersey State Board of Optometrists to use or prescribe pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry before having completed credentialing requirements in ocular pharmacology approved and administered by the New Jersey State Board of Optometrists

telemedicine_authorized.quote: a health care provider who establishes a proper provider-patient relationship with a patient may remotely provide health care services to a patient through the use of telemedicine

criminal_background_check_required.quote: the division is authorized, for purposes of facilitating determinations concerning licensure eligibility, to require the fingerprinting of each applicant in accordance with applicable State and federal laws, rules and regulations
